title: The Pullman house's big front window stands on its dressed sill
items: At 1729 Prairie, the tall arched window on the front's main floor now sits on a projecting stone sill, with a block at each end, as the 1890 Albertype plate draws it.
Under it a longer sill on two small brackets tops a sunk stone panel that runs down to the base of the wall.
How far each piece stands out from the wall is our estimate; the plate shows the front straight on, so that depth can't be read.
